locations.name: Washington Street, Dumbo
locations.factShort: Dumbo (or DUMBO, an acronym for Down Under the Manhattan Bridge Overpass) is a neighborhood in the New York City borough of Brooklyn. It encompasses two sections: one situated between the Manhattan and Brooklyn Bridges, which connect Brooklyn to Manhattan across the East River, and another extending eastward from the Manhattan Bridge to the Vinegar Hill area.

locations.name: The Strand
locations.factShort: The Strand Bookstore is an independent bookstore located at 828 Broadway, at the corner of East 12th Street in the East Village neighborhood of Manhattan, New York City, two blocks south of Union Square.

locations.name: The Forest Park Carousel
locations.factShort: Forest Park is a park in the New York City borough of Queens. Spanning 543 acres, it is the tenth-largest park in New York City and the third-largest in Queens.

locations.name: St. Ann's Church
locations.factShort: The Parish of St. Ann-St. Brendan is a parish of the Archdiocese of New York located in the Bronx, New York. It was created on August 1, 2015, by the merger of two previous parishes, the Shrine Church of St. Ann and the Parish of St. Brendan.

locations.name: Chumley's
locations.factShort: Chumley's was an historic pub and former speakeasy at 86 Bedford Street, between Grove and Barrow Streets, in the West Village neighborhood of Greenwich Village, Manhattan, New York City.
